description: A whole Surge synthesizer in one module, playing the patches installed with the plugin from a polyphonic gate and a volt-per-octave pitch input.

params.text: Scales both outputs, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both audio inputs before the patch reads them, from silence to unity gain.
Steps through the patch categories; the synthesizer carries on playing the loaded patch until the load button is pressed.
Steps through the patches in the browsed category; the synthesizer carries on playing the loaded patch until the load button is pressed.
Loads the browsed patch into the synthesizer. A red lamp is lit whenever the browsed patch differs from the one playing.

inputs.text: The left audio input into the patch, for oscillators that take an audio input; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right audio input into the patch.
Sets the pitch of each note as it starts, one volt per octave, with 0V giving middle C.
Sets the velocity of each note as it starts, 12.7 per volt so 10V gives full velocity; with nothing patched every note plays at velocity 100.
A rising edge starts a note and the fall releases it; the number of channels here sets the polyphony.
Bends the pitch, -5V to 5V covering the patch's full bend range.
Sends the mod wheel to the patch, as MIDI CC 1 at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sends channel aftertouch to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over -5V to 5V.
Sends aftertouch for the note playing on each channel, at 12.7 per volt; patching it puts the synthesizer into MPE mode.
Sends MPE timbre to the patch, as MIDI CC 74 at 12.7 per volt.
Sends MIDI CC 41 to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sends MIDI CC 42 to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sends MIDI CC 43 to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sends MIDI CC 44 to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sends MIDI CC 45 to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sends MIDI CC 46 to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sends MIDI CC 47 to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sends MIDI CC 48 to the patch, at 12.7 per volt over 0V to 10V.
Sets the tempo the patch runs its own tempo-synced rates at, doubling with every volt from 60 BPM at 0V; with nothing patched the tempo is 120 BPM.

outputs.text: The left output of the synthesizer; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the synthesizer.

notes: the synthesizer stays silent until a gate arrives at the Gate input; a patch is loaded and the knobs work, but a note only starts on a rising gate.
the patches are the factory set shipped inside the plugin folder, in categories including Basses, Brass, Keys, Leads, Pads, Percussion, Polysynths and Templates.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
